name: stata-research-guard
description: Researcher-readable Stata with original command evidence and concrete independent review.

interface.shortDescription: Readable Stata, original help, concrete peer advice.
interface.longDescription: Write coherent research stages with visible specifications and native Stata commands. Original help and selected paper context support implementation; fresh peer advice makes refactoring defects explicit. Optional source-section navigation and caller-controlled rule reuse reduce repetition without replacing source evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $stata-replication-workflow to inspect the actual project, obtain the needed original command evidence, and write direct researcher-readable Stata. For refactoring, get concrete fresh peer advice and carry it through implementation, execution, and review. Keep broad research stages together and preserve the user's research and output contracts.
